title: One zero-test step
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean multi-tape Turing machine, let $x,v$ be Boolean words, and let $o$ be an oracle. Suppose a configuration $c$ of $M$ on input $v$ has state $s$. For every natural number $i$, one step of the compiled oracle program from the image of $c$ with counter value $i$ and phase $\mathrm{zt}$ equals the image of $c$ with the same counter value and phase $\mathrm{work}(\mathrm{none},\mathrm{true})$ if $i=0$, and phase $\mathrm{dD}$ otherwise.
